entities.name: Yoshitaka Egawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yoshitaka Egawa  was a Japanese basketball player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1964 Summer Olympics. Egawa died in Kisarazu on 26 December 2024, at the age of 82.
